research_question: Does the evidence-provenance discriminator remain nontrivial when fixed provenance carrier words and fixed opaque symbols cannot solve the task?
hypothesis: Fully crossing episode-local opaque provenance mappings and codebook order, with a disjoint frozen-holdout atom alphabet, can force the evaluator blueprint to depend on current-episode binding rather than fixed atom or presentation priors.
counterhypothesis: The source gate is still only a constructed oracle problem; a model may fail to learn the required composition or may exploit renderer/tokenizer regularities that do not exist at blueprint level.
adjudication_boundary: The committed gate proves deterministic factorial coverage and several shortcut baselines only. It does not prove Qwen3.5-0.8B behavior, rendered-byte/tokenizer cleanliness, model-internal J-Space causality, training efficacy, or dataset admission.

relation_binding.mapping_rule: all six S3 mappings per split
relation_binding.codebook_order_rule: all six display orders per mapping

relation_to_current_curriculum: This is a concrete nontraining B1/B6 bridge candidate: episode-local BIND/ROUTE/REMAP is required to recover evidence-provenance semantics, while promotion authority remains outside learned/model-visible content. It does not replace the frozen Trigger-2 B0-B6 curriculum or exact ABI/tokenizer/render gates.
next_discriminator: Bind the blueprint to the exact selected production ABI atoms, renderer, tokenizer and input tensor only after those identities are admitted. Re-run chain-only/order-only/atom-only leakage tests over rendered bytes/tokens, freeze the disjoint holdout before model execution, and only after runtime quiescence plus explicit FREE model execution authority evaluate the selected Qwen3.5-0.8B checkpoint.
